pages.text: Either color adds extra random block ticks near you. Effects combine from both colors. The range starts at 2 blocks with 3 tick attempts per game tick, rising to 5 blocks and 18 attempts at peak growth strength.

pages.title: Grow at Your Feet
pages.text: The extra ticks can advance crops and other randomly ticking blocks. They sample positions, so aim your movement at a dense plot of crops. Crops still need suitable soil, light and other normal growth conditions.

pages.title: Mob Targeting
pages.text: Mobs can fail to acquire you as a target. One serving near its peak gives about a 25% chance to block a new target. Overlapping doses increase it. At full avoidance, mobs also drop an existing target.

pages.title: Red or Brown
pages.text: Both colors give the same gameplay benefits. Their color, motion and contextual effects differ. See $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/mushroom_batch)making a batch$(/l) for the two drying recipes.
